body.objective: Turn the fixed-Q_rel clock obstruction into an exact charge-clock complementarity theorem and decide whether the unrestricted variable-Q_rel counterflow theory is a healthy classical theory with physical time translation rather than a D-gauge theory.
body.stop_condition: Import TWO_PHASE_COUNTERFLOW_CAUSAL_BV_PARENT_V1, TWO_PHASE_COUNTERFLOW_FIXED_CHARGE_REDUCED_HEALTH_OBSTRUCTION_V1 and the isolated-background classification by exact hashes. First prove the global symplectic dichotomy from i_D Omega=Omega_background delta Q_rel: on the derived fixed-Q_rel fibre followed by the R_rel quotient, the D-evolving relative phase is removed; on the unrestricted carrier, the full (delta psi_0,delta Q_rel) Darboux pair survives, R_rel is a charged global symmetry, D has Hamiltonian Omega_background Q_rel, and K=D-Omega_background R_rel is the background stabilizer. State and prove the corresponding finite-rank generalization for a declared charge matrix, including whether any intermediate local symplectic reduction can retain a D-evolving clock while making D null. Then complete the nonhomogeneous physical reduction of the unrestricted 70-row parent: cohomology dimensions by Hodge/harmonic sector, descended cyclic/Lee-Wald pairing and inertia, radicals, characteristic roots and geometric multiplicities, Jordan chains, gradient cone and real growing modes. Decide exactly whether accepting charged D yields a positive stable relative-clock theory, or certify the first failed physical sector. Preserve the fixed-charge obstruction as a separate branch; do not average the two phase spaces. Land exact maps, basis tables, independent reconstruction, charge/radical and sign mutations, schema, tier receipt, report, atlas fragment and roadmap/paper disposition.
body.current_gate: physical viability of the unrestricted charged-time branch after the fixed-charge D-gauge branch loses its clock
body.forbid: no fixed-Q_rel quotient called a physical clock theory; no charged R_rel or D deleted as gauge; no positive homogeneous trace used as an all-Hodge health theorem; no K substituted for raw D; no variable-charge result promoted to the fixed-charge fibre; no causal parent called stable; no observer, quantum, particle, scattering or unitarity promotion
activates: a charge-typed nonlinear and quantum counterflow programme
body.resource_hint: PROOF-FIRST CHARGE DICHOTOMY. The first deliverable is the exact symplectic reduction theorem, not another coefficient search. Reuse the certified 70-row parent and fixed-charge matrices; do not rebuild them. Split the all-Hodge census only if one normalized carrier and an assembly receipt preserve completeness.
